# Assay README Template

## Assay Title

Deiodinase assay

## Assay Description

To characterize D3 activity in the cell lines, we first measured endogenous D3 activity in the cell lysate  

Deiodinase activity (D3) was determined in cell lysate for MO3.13 and SK-N-AS cells. Cell lysates were incubated with 1 nM T3 and 200.000 cpm [125I]T3 for D3, 
and the indicated concentrations of EDCs or vehicle in PED10 for 120 minutes. Samples were analysed on UPLC (Acquity premier, Waters Chromatography B.V., Netherlands) coupled to a RAMONA star (Elisia Raytest, Belgium) detector.
D3 activity was expressed as fmol/min/mg protein. 

Reference compounds tested: iopanoic acid, xanthohumol 
EDCs tested: Amiodarone, NH-3, silychristin, sulfobromophthalein, cefuroxime, chlorpyrifos, mono-butyl phthalate, Polybrominated diphenyl ethers-99, Tetrabromobisphenol A

## File Organization
[Briefly explain how do the files in the folder relate to eachother]

The paper has two parts: characterisation of deiodinase (D3) activity of two cell lines (MO3.13, SK-N-AS) and testing reference compounds of EDCs. 
assay2_characterisation: processed and raw data files of characterisation of three cell lines
assay2:_EDCs: processed and raw data files of endocrine disrupting chemicals tested in the assay

## Comments
[Any other comments that are important to understand your data that you could not express in the metadata template]

In file assay2_EDCs, 'HC' is mentioned. This means that only the highest concentration of the EDCs are measured, which holds true for all compounds tested with this assay.
